formalization.objective: minimise elastic strain energy density h(e) in meV/A^3 for diamond C
constraints: HSE06 band gap in [1.9, 2.0] eV (target 2.0 eV), evaluated with full HSE06 at the final strain and not the zero-strain scissor
Born stability: all eigenvalues of the stiffness matrix at the strained state > 0
strain is Green-Lagrange, Voigt order, tensor shear, fractions
formalization.level_of_theory: PBE for search and h; HSE06 required for the gap; hse_scissor (zero-strain per-valley corrections) used only as a screening proxy
formalization.stability: Born stability via elastic_stability at the final strain; not run on this candidate

designer.explanation: NOT VERIFIED. The previous candidate failed because the zero-strain Dx scissor overestimated the HSE gap by about 0.16 eV. I added 18 PBE points (63 in total) and re-optimised. The best state has PBE h = 22.3 meV/A^3 and a PBE gap of 0.970 eV with Dx as CBM; Dy and Dz are within 0.14 eV. The reported eg_ev of 2.069 is the scissor-corrected estimate and is probably too high, so the true HSE gap may be near 1.9 eV and could fall outside the 1.9-2.0 eV window. The full HSE06 check (verify_hse) was denied by the permission system, so the gap is unconfirmed. The Born stability check and the uniaxial <100>, <110> and <111> comparison were not run. The surrogate's held-out gap error was 0.09-0.29 eV, which is not enough to claim the window is met. Constraints are therefore marked unsatisfied until HSE is run.

verifier.eg_level: HSE06 (full, verify_hse at the candidate strain)
issues: Full HSE06 gap at the candidate is 1.502 eV (CBM Dx). That is below the required window [1.9, 2.0] eV and about 0.57 eV below the claimed 2.069 eV, so the gap constraint fails.

The claimed 2.069 eV is the hse_scissor proxy, which applies the zero-strain per-valley corrections. At this strain the Dx correction is about +0.53 eV (PBE 0.970 to HSE 1.502), not the zero-strain 1.099 eV. The proxy overestimates the gap.
The claimed 2.069 eV is also above 2.0 eV, so it was already outside the stated window even on the proxy.
PBE reproduces the claim: h = 22.296 meV/A^3 and PBE gap 0.970 eV, with scissor gap 2.069 eV. The h value is therefore not in doubt.
Born stability holds: min eigenvalue 96.0 GPa, stable. The team had not run this check.

The strain is at the search bound: e4 = 0.09, e5 = -0.09 and e6 = -0.09 all sit at |e| = 0.09. The strain is very large, and the VBM is off Gamma at [0.333, 0.333, 0.5]. The proxy and surrogate are unreliable in this regime.

No comparison with uniaxial <100>, <110> or <111> loading was provided or checked. The optimality claim has no DFT support. The candidate needs re-optimisation with HSE-level constraints, for example a higher PBE gap target, to reach an HSE gap of 1.9 to 2.0 eV. About 29 budget units remain, enough for only one more full HSE check.
